analyst.summary: Happiest Minds Technologies, a digital engineering and IT services company, delivered healthy and accelerating revenue growth through FY26 and into the June 2026 quarter (14.3% year-on-year), well above the industry average at present. Borrowings have risen substantially over the past two years, and we could not confirm from available data how much of that reflects real financial debt versus accounting for office leases. We rate it a Hold: strong growth momentum, but a debt trend worth understanding better before extending more confidence.
